# TernaryChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTernaryChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasTernaryChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasTernaryChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasTernaryChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartEngineElement`](UltraCanvasChartEngineElement.md) → [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Mixes of three parts that add up to 100 % - vote shares, soil texture, alloys - as points in a triangle (ternary plot)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasTernaryChart](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTernaryChart.md)
- [UltraCanvasTernaryChartProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTernaryChartProposal.md)
- [UltraCanvasChartEngine](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasChartEngine.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTernaryChart> CreateTernaryChart( const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTernaryChart(const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onZoomChanged` | `std::function<void()> onZoomChanged` | After every zoom change, by code, drag or double click. |
| `onPointClick` | `std::function<void(size_t seriesIndex, size_t pointIndex)> onPointClick` | A click on a point: its series and its index in that series. |
| `onRegionClick` | `std::function<void(int regionIndex)> onRegionClick` | A click on a region (not on a point in it): its index in the model. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

| `SetReadingGuide` | `void SetReadingGuide(bool show)` | The three grid lines through the pointer, to the edges that carry their numbers, with the pointer's shares (and region) beside it. |
| `SetBubbleRadiusRange` | `void SetBubbleRadiusRange(double smallest, double largest)` | The bubble radii, in pixels, for the smallest and the largest point size; points without a size keep their series' marker radius. |
| `SetZoom` | `bool SetZoom(double minimumA, double minimumB, double minimumC)` | Show only the sub-triangle where each part is at least its minimum (shares, 0..1). Refused - false, nothing changed - when a minimum is negative or the three leave less than 2 % of the triangle. |
| `SetZoomByDrag` | `void SetZoomByDrag(bool enabled)` | Dragging across the triangle zooms to the smallest sub-triangle holding both ends of the drag; a double click shows the whole triangle again. On by default. |
| `SetDensity` | `void SetDensity(int subdivisions)` | Cut the (zoomed) triangle into subdivisions^2 small triangles and colour each by how many visible points fall in it; 0 turns it off. For thousands of points, where markers would hide one another. |
| `SetDensityColormap` | `void SetDensityColormap(HeatmapColormap map)` |  |
| `SetDensityContours` | `void SetDensityContours(int levels)` | Contour lines over the density at this many evenly spaced levels; 0 = none. |
| `SetShowPoints` | `void SetShowPoints(bool show)` | The markers themselves; turn them off over a dense density view. |
